tour.welcome.title: How to use this page
tour.welcome.body: The next steps point at the real controls. Press Next to continue, or click outside to close.
tour.open.title: Open a file
tour.open.body: Open a file from this computer, Google Drive, or OneDrive. The open file is kept as a session on this device.
tour.menu.title: Menu
tour.menu.body: Open a file, export .xlsx .csv or .sqlite, undo, find and replace, and reopen a saved session.
tour.export.title: Export
tour.export.body: Download the sheet you are editing as .xlsx, .csv, or .sqlite.
tour.undo.title: Undo
tour.undo.body: Undo and redo sit side by side. The shortcuts are Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y.
tour.find.title: Find and replace
tour.find.body: Ctrl+H opens find. Filter first to see the matching rows, then replace all.
tour.row.title: A row
tour.row.body: Click a row to load it into the form. The checkbox and bookmark are at the start of the row. Double-click a cell to edit it in the table.
tour.sum.title: Totals
tour.sum.body: Number columns are summed on this row.
tour.form-nav.title: Move between rows
tour.form-nav.body: Type a row number and press Enter. Last jumps to the end. The arrows move to the next or previous row.
tour.form-fields.title: Fields
tour.form-fields.body: Edit here and the table updates immediately. Long text has an expand button. Date fields can open a calendar.
tour.form-actions.title: Row actions
tour.form-actions.body: Add a row at the end, copy this row down, delete it, clear it, or edit columns.
tour.form-add.title: Add a row
tour.form-add.body: This inserts a blank row just after the one you are viewing. Open the menu to pick a form type.
tour.status.title: Status bar
tour.status.body: Row count, column count, file name, and the range on screen.
tour.home.title: No file yet
tour.home.body: Drop a file here, or load the sample data to try the editor.
tour.screen.title: Table and form
tour.screen.body: On a phone, one screen is visible. On a wide screen, Edit shows the table and form, and Preview shows the Excel page.
tour.table.title: Table
tour.table.body: Search rows, filter, pick the header row, or jump to a row number. Click a row to open it in the form.
tour.form.title: Form
tour.form.body: Edit the fields of the selected row. The … button adds or deletes a row and edits columns.
tour.sheets.title: Sheets
tour.sheets.body: Switch sheets here. + adds a sheet. Double-click a name to rename it.
home.pick.source.below.computer.accepts: Or pick a source below. This computer accepts .xlsx, .xls, and .csv.
home.try.now.without.file: or try it now without a file:
intro.excel.editor.edit.spreadsheets.bro: Excel Editor — edit spreadsheets in the browser or on your computer.
intro.ezxlform.lets.you.view.edit: EzXLForm lets you view and edit Excel data as a form. Pick a row in the table, type in the form, or edit a cell directly. Large files are paged, and find-and-replace can be paused.
intro.open.edit.xlsx.xls.csv: Open and edit .xlsx, .xls, and .csv files, with several sheets in one workbook.
intro.form.table.share.screen.double: Form and table share the screen. Double-click a cell to edit it.
intro.find.replace.preview.excel.undo: Find and replace, preview Excel, undo, and keep the session on this computer.
intro.tauri.desktop.build.windows.macos: A Tauri desktop build for Windows, macOS, and Linux.
intro.open.editor.page.drop.file: Open the editor on this page. Drop a file or return to a saved session.
intro.download.latest.installer.button.p: Download the latest installer. The button picks the file for this operating system.

format.title: Format Cells
format.tab.later: This tab is not saved on the column. Use Number to set how the value is shown.
format.hint.general: No forced type. The value stays as entered.
format.hint.number: A number with decimal places, a thousands separator, and a negative style.
format.hint.currency: A number with a currency symbol. Negatives can sit in parentheses.
format.hint.accounting: The currency symbol stays in front. Zero is shown as a dash.
format.hint.date: Choose how the date is written.
format.hint.time: A number is a fraction of a day: 0.5 is shown as 12:00.
format.hint.percentage: A value of 0.12 is shown as 12%.
format.hint.fraction: Show the decimal part as a fraction.
format.hint.scientific: Show the number in exponential form, such as 1.23E+03.
format.hint.text: Keep the text, even when it looks like a number.
format.hint.custom: Number codes use 0 and #. Date codes use dd, MM, and yyyy. Separate negative and zero with semicolons.
